title: Croxyub Hub  ESP Movement Mobile
features:
Croxyub Hub – Features

Player Role ESP – See everyone's role (Sniper, Hider, Lobby) with colors and name tags above their head. Toggle on/off.

ESP – Highlights any Players. Optional team colors.

Walk Speed & Jump Power – Sliders to change your speed and jump height. Stays on after you die.

Infinite Jump – Self‑explanatory.

Client Invisible – Makes your character invisible to you.

Client Bring Hiders – Drags Hider‑role players toward you on your screen .

Auto‑Respawn – Your speed, jump, and invisibility reapply when you respawn.

All settings save automatically.
